messages:
Asha K: heads-up — finance pinged about inflated per-route costs for a handful of tenants. looks like route tags aren't flowing through the metering pipeline when requests hit the routing fallback.
Miguel R: can you share an example?
Asha K: here's a snippet from invoice_preview for tenant t-orca: shows large `unattributed` cost bucket around 2026-03-24T18:00.
```
invoice_preview: {
  tenant: t-orca,
  window: 2026-03-24T18:00:00Z,
  total_tokens: 12,345,
  route_costs: { "chat.v1": 8000, "unattributed": 4345 }
}
```
Asha K: we expect unattributed to be near zero; investigation shows routing fallback to model_alias=redwood:compat caused route headers to be dropped by proxy.
Tom B: routing proxy currently strips non-whitelisted headers during fallback path to avoid leakage. we probably forgot to whitelist `X-Route-Tag` for the fallback microproxy.
Nora S: two concerns: (1) attribution correctness, (2) console UX for customers seeing sudden unattributed spikes. i propose: whitelist route tag header in fallback, and emit `billing.route_tag` events in aggregator as a fallback enrichment if header missing.
Miguel R: enrichment in aggregator is heavier but more resilient. alternative: include route metadata in finalizer by resolving model_alias -> canonical_route using offline mapping. that keeps aggregator lean.
Tom B: offline mapping works for stable aliases, but we have dynamic routing policies (experiment overrides) that live in routing-service. finalizer may not have latest overrides.
Asha K: decision matrix: fast fix = whitelist header in proxy (low risk), medium fix = aggregator enrichment + tombstone dedupe, long-term = routing-service publishes canonical route events to `routing.canonical.v1` topic that downstream services consume.
Nora S: UX: console should show attribution source (producer/header/enrichment/fallback). small pill next to each route cost: e.g., "chat.v1 (hdr)" or "chat.v1 (enrich)" and a tooltip explaining confidence.
Miguel R: telemetry: add `billing.attribution.source` tag and `billing.attribution.unattributed.count`. spike alert when unattributed% > 5% for any tenant for 10m.
Tom B: I'll open a small PR to whitelist X-Route-Tag in fallback proxy and add unit test. target deploy in next canary.
Asha K: I'll add console mockups and the confidence pill copy.
Nora S: i'll own the routing.canonical.v1 spec and a consumer shim for finalizer. suggest topic retention 7d and idempotent events with route_id + epoch.
billing-bot: note: new kafka topic requested: routing.canonical.v1 (retention 7d) by @Nora S.
sre-bot: scheduling canary deploy: proxy-fallback v0.9.2 to 5 tenants in eu-central. monitor `billing.attribution.unattributed.count`.
Miguel R: follow-up: we should also log a trace id on unattributed events and surface quick search in console so support can trace back path (edge->fallback->aggregator->finalizer->invoice).
Asha K: agreed. i'll add trace_id to the unattributed event payload. thanks all — will update when proxy canary is green. :+1:
